evidence: The elemental depth profiling was carried out using time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA). Residual hydrogen was determined by nuclear resonance broadening (NRB) technique [lo] with the 6.39 MeV resonance of the reaction 'H(15N, 12C)12C. The 37 MeV 176Lu7+ beam for TOF-ERDA and 15N2+ beam for the NRB were obtained from a 5 MV tandem accelerator EPG-11-10 at the Accelerator Laboratory, University of Helsinki. Porosity and corrosion protection properties of the films were investigated by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) in long-term immersion tests. Structural analysis was carried out with a Philips MPD 1880 x-ray powder diffractometer using CuK, radiation. Film thicknesses and optical parameters were evaluated by fitting transmittance spectra measured in a wavelength region of 370-100 nm with a Hitachi U-2000 spectrophotometer.
